---
title: "Teaching with the slides"
---

You are welcome to teach with these slides, in whole or in part, and to adapt them for your own
course.

## Building and adapting the slides

The [repository](https://github.com/xuyiqing/panel-lectures) has the LaTeX Beamer source of every
deck, every figure, and the R scripts that redraw the figures from data or by simulation. All
references sit in one file, `references.bib`, so each deck's reference list is rebuilt from it.
With TeX Live 2023 or later, `make` builds the six handouts and `make animated` the versions with
animations. The [README](https://github.com/xuyiqing/panel-lectures#readme) has the details, and
[SOURCES.md](https://github.com/xuyiqing/panel-lectures/blob/main/SOURCES.md) records where every
figure comes from.

All six decks share one look, set in `common/`. To change the colors of every deck, edit the four
colors at the top of `common/theme.tex`.

## Citing the lectures

Xu, Yiqing. 2026. *Lectures on Causal Panel Analysis.* Lecture slides, version 1.0.0.
<https://github.com/xuyiqing/panel-lectures>.
